The image should feel like layered mixed-media street art made from torn posters, ink illustration, manga textures, watercolor washes, newspaper print, spray paint, and graphic design fragments. The overall palette combines deep midnight blues, black, cream paper tones, neon magenta, crimson red, cherry blossom pink, and industrial gray. In the upper left, show a large red sun behind Mount Fuji with cherry blossom branches crossing the corner, and a small airplane in the sky. Along the left side and lower left, depict a crowded Tokyo-like city street packed with pedestrians, glowing signs, dense buildings, and a tall cylindrical building with a smiley face near the top and a vertical sign reading AI IS WATCHING YOU. Include stylized Japanese-style signage on nearby buildings. Add a giant wave motif and a pagoda integrated into the urban scene. In the upper center, place a dark industrial skyline with multiple smokestacks releasing massive black clouds, transitioning into a giant astronaut floating forward with one hand reaching out. In the upper right, transform the sky into outer space with stars, a swirling purple-and-blue nebula, and a black hole. Beneath that, create a futuristic eco-city of sleek skyscrapers mixed with lush trees, cliffs, and cascading waterfalls. Add a glowing neon sign on the far right that reads DREAMING IS FREE. Near the astronaut, place a torn poster with the text THE FUTURE IS UNWRITTEN in large type and below it But we are the authors in smaller type. Across the center, layer floral elements including cherry blossoms and large roses around a partially obscured central human portrait to give the sense of fragmented identity. In the lower center, show a person from behind wearing a dark hooded jacket with graffiti-style text reading QUESTION EVERYTHING. Around them, include additional cutout portrait fragments, a Mondrian-inspired geometric block of red, blue, yellow, white, and black rectangles, a classical marble bust fragment, a white dove in flight, a small protest sign that reads EQUALITY ≠ EQUITY, and a seated figure looking toward the futuristic landscape. In the lower left corner, include part of a noir-style person in a dark hat and coat, and in the lower right, part of a manga-style female face in profile. Scatter graffiti, torn edges, ink splatters, layered paper textures, and poster remnants throughout. The composition should be extremely busy, cinematic, and thought-provoking, balancing hope and anxiety, tradition and technology, nature and urban overload, in the style of a high-detail contemporary collage mural.\

prompt_en: Create a clean vector-style mascot logo for a hot dog shop named Chunkydog. The design is centered on a white background inside a rounded rectangular sign with a thick black outline and an off-white fill. At the top, show exactly 1 cheerful cartoon boy mascot leaning over the sign: medium-brown skin, simple dot eyes, small rounded nose, smiling mouth, short curly black hair, and a yellow baseball cap worn backward with a white adjustable strap. He wears exactly 2 visible clothing pieces: a white T-shirt and orange overalls with black outlines, stitching details, a front pocket, and 2 round overall buttons. Along the bottom of the sign, create exactly 1 checkerboard border made of two rows of alternating dark red and off-white squares, approximately 18 columns across, aligned to the rounded sign edge. Use thick smooth black outlines, flat colors, friendly children’s-book proportions, minimal shading, and a polished restaurant logo look. Keep the composition symmetrical, readable, and uncluttered; no extra characters, no extra food items, no shadows outside the logo, no watermark.\

Goal: Create a dreamy seaside anime-themed cafe brand mockup for 泡沫の光 カフェ, using a soft pastel lavender and pink palette, elegant floral borders, seashell motifs, and a gentle ocean-sunset atmosphere.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 composition, photorealistic product display with anime illustration printed on objects, shallow depth of field, warm backlit sunset glow, soft bokeh, high-detail textures.

Setting: A wooden outdoor cafe table on a beach terrace at sunset. The ocean fills the background with sparkling waves and a low sun near the horizon. Add blurred pastel flowers behind the display, mainly white, blush pink, and lavender, with a romantic coastal cafe mood.

Main branded elements: Show exactly 5 visible cafe merchandise/display pieces arranged on the table: 1 tall pastel paper shopping bag on the left with rope handles, 1 large takeaway coffee cup in the center with a white plastic lid, 1 upright acrylic menu sign on a small wooden base on the right, 1 transparent acrylic QR-code card lying flat in the front-left foreground, and 1 rectangular serving tray in the front-right foreground. Each item should share the same delicate lavender floral pattern and ocean-inspired branding.

Character illustration: On the paper bag, cup, and tray, print a circular anime illustration of a soft blonde anime girl in a pale blue summer dress, sitting by the sea, with wavy hair, gentle eyes, and a shy hand-near-face pose. The illustration should look watercolor-like, airy, and pastel, framed by tiny flowers and sea motifs.

Text content: Use Japanese branding text on the bag and cup: 「泡沫の光 カフェ」 with “- CAFÉ -” below it. The upright menu sign should have the heading “MENU” and a small shell icon, with exactly 5 menu items and prices: 「潮風ラテ」650, 「桜シェルソーダ」680, 「星屑クリームソーダ」700, 「乙女のベリーパフェ」720, 「夢見るレアチーズ」660. The flat acrylic card should contain a QR-code area and small decorative Japanese cafe text, but it may be partially unreadable due to perspective and reflections.

Foreground props: Add exactly 2 small seaside props on the tray: 1 pale pink ridged shell-shaped dessert or shell ornament, and 1 small pink starfish beside it. Keep them neatly placed on the branded tray.

Visual style: Soft romantic product photography, pastel anime cafe aesthetic, pearlescent highlights, translucent acrylic reflections, creamy lighting, elegant floral line art, delicate shells, starfish, and ocean foam motifs. Use realistic shadows on the wooden table and a softly blurred background.

Constraints: Keep the composition clean and premium, avoid extra people, avoid modern corporate logos, avoid clutter, preserve the exact count of 5 branded display pieces, 5 menu items, and 2 foreground seaside props.\

prompt_en: Using the person in the attached reference image as the sole protagonist, depict a glamorous and cinematic urban landscape where a sophisticated metropolitan commercial district is taken over by a giant fashion advertisement of that person. Faithfully maintain facial features, hairstyle, hair color, eye impression, age, body type, clothing, shoes, atmosphere, and expression format (photorealistic, anime, or illustration) from the reference image. Do not inherit the background, floor, shadows, lighting, margins, or original pose; reconstruct the image using only the person as a new urban advertisement. Do not simply paste the entire reference image onto the giant billboard. Fix the composition: place a vertically long giant advertisement centered on the full body of the reference person, viewed from the front or nearly from the front, slightly to the right of the center. In the left foreground, place the same person large enough on a small, clean high-altitude work platform projecting from the building. Do not make the city a super-distant view or the person a tiny dot. The giant advertisement should be a non-digital large panel rather than an LED. Do not reuse the original background or include text, logos, or brand names. The person on the platform is the same person in the ad. They should be standing naturally, having paused their work. Ensure the face, full body, clothing, and spray can are clearly visible. They should hold a spray can naturally in one hand below waist level with the nozzle pointing down; do not depict them reaching for the ad, spraying, or creating mist/trails. The other hand should rest naturally. The combination of the finished brushstroke background, platform, and spray can should indicate the person is involved in creating their own giant advertisement. title: 月夜狐巫女参考表
author: れいんLain
categories: 游戏素材,漫画 / 分镜,动漫 / 漫画,角色
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a polished anime VTuber character reference sheet for Tsukiyo, a moon-dwelling fox-shrine maiden with long pink hair and fox ears, in a delicate Japanese fantasy style.

Canvas: Portrait-oriented character design sheet, pale warm ivory background, soft pink decorative borders, sakura petals, thin red-pink frame lines, elegant symmetrical spacing, high-resolution illustration. Overall palette: white, blush pink, crimson red, black, gold accents.

Header: At the top center, large title text: 「ツキヨ / Tsukiyo」. Under it, smaller subtitle text: 「月を宿す狐神の巫女」. Add a small circular moon-and-fox emblem at the upper left with cherry blossoms and light ornamental flourishes.

Main layout: The left and center area contains exactly 3 full-body turnaround views of the character, labeled vertically in small beige tags: 「正面」 for front view, 「側面」 for side view, and 「背面」 for back view. The front view shows her standing calmly with arms slightly lowered and sleeves hanging; the side view shows her profile and long hair flowing down; the back view emphasizes extremely long straight pink hair reaching near the hem and the back of the obi. Keep all three figures consistent in proportions and outfit.

Character details: She is a youthful elegant anime woman with very long pastel pink hair, large pink fox ears with white inner fur, golden eyes, pale skin, soft bangs, and a refined calm expression. She wears a white shrine maiden-inspired kimono dress with translucent wide sleeves, pink cherry blossom patterns, red trim, black inner collar, and a dramatic red-and-black floral obi belt with gold detailing. Include a large red flower ornament and ribbon on one fox ear, matching red ribbons on the sleeves, decorative cords, tassels, and a round gold-and-pink waist charm. Footwear is traditional white tabi with red-and-black geta or platform sandals. The back view should show the kimono train and sleeve transparency with soft pink floral gradients.

Right column: Add exactly 1 large close-up portrait panel at the upper right showing the head, fox ears, hair ornament, collar, and shoulder area. Beneath it, create a DETAIL section with exactly 2 stacked detail panels: first, a close crop of the ear ornament labeled 「耳元飾り」 with small explanatory Japanese-style text; second, a close crop of the obi and waist ornament labeled 「帯・腰飾り」 with small explanatory Japanese-style text. At the bottom right, create exactly 1 SD / CHIBI panel labeled “SD / CHIBI”, showing a tiny super-deformed full-body version of the same character standing in the same outfit, surrounded by subtle petal effects and a small circular ground ripple.

Expression row: Along the lower left, create an EXPRESSION section with exactly 5 small bust panels. Each panel shows the same character from the shoulders up with fox ears and hair ornament, labeled in Japanese from left to right: 「通常」 normal, 「微笑み」 gentle smile, 「妖艶」 alluring, 「静寂」 quiet/serene, 「威圧」 intimidating. Keep the expressions subtle and elegant, not exaggerated.

Profile section: At the bottom left, create a PROFILE box with compact Japanese text lines. Include visible structured fields such as species, age, height, personality, likes, and dislikes, but keep the small text decorative and secondary. To the right of the profile box, include a short Japanese description paragraph about a beautiful fox deity shrine maiden seen on moonlit nights, with a faint crescent moon and sakura motif behind it.

Visual style: High-detail anime character sheet, clean line art, soft watercolor-like pink shading, ornate Japanese shrine maiden aesthetic, gentle glow, glossy hair highlights, intricate textile patterns, elegant UI-like reference sheet design. Use readable section labels, thin ornamental dividers, sakura icons, and refined typography.

Constraints: Use exactly 3 full-body turnaround views, exactly 5 expression panels, exactly 2 detail panels, exactly 1 close-up portrait, and exactly 1 chibi panel. Keep the sheet cohesive and uncluttered. No watermark, no social media UI, no realistic photography, no extra characters.\

A person's ambitions have become visible.

wild nature
forests
lakes
exploration
The other side:
modern skyline
architecture
glowing city lights
future possibilities
The subject stands between both worlds.
Representing choice.
TYPOGRAPHY

BUILD WHAT BUILDS YOU

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a vertical grand-opening hoarding poster for a boutique coffee shop, featuring a premium beige-and-coffee-brown visual identity, a realistic 3D folded construction-wall display, large promotional typography, and store-opening information.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 9:16 ratio, warm cream marble background with subtle coffee-swirled texture, soft studio lighting, elegant premium retail advertising style.

Brand: Use the cafe logo at the top: a simple brown line icon of a cup forming a smiling face, with the brand name Mellow Cup and Chinese subtitle “慢杯咖啡”. Overall mood is calm, mellow, artisanal, and slightly luxurious.

Layout: Top centered logo and brand name, then a small English line “NEW STORE OPENS” with tiny decorative dots on both sides. Below it, place a huge dark-brown brush-calligraphy Chinese headline: 拍围挡·喝咖啡. Under the headline, add a rounded capsule promotion bar: a dark brown left pill with large white number “1000”, connected to a beige outlined right pill reading “杯拿铁免费送”.

Central 3D installation: Show exactly 1 freestanding folded hoarding display made of 3 visible vertical panels, standing on a glossy cream floor with soft reflections. Panel 1, left: dark coffee-marble swirl texture with large white Chinese stacked text “现磨咖啡 / 鲜奶拿铁 / 手作甜点”, small logo text near the bottom “Mellow Cup”, and tiny English tagline “SLOW COFFEE / SOFT MOMENTS”. Panel 2, center: light beige stone-paper texture with the Mellow Cup logo near top, a taped paper notice containing “1000杯 / 拿铁免费送”, smaller lines “拍照打卡即领” and “活动时间：开业首周 / 每天限量，先到先得”, plus a hand-written “For you” and a faint circular coffee stamp near the bottom. Panel 3, right: dark coffee-marble swirl texture with large white handwritten script “Mellow Cup”, a realistic takeaway latte cup with the Mellow Cup logo, and a small taped note reading “随手一拍 / 就出片 / 到店还可 / 领咖啡”.

Bottom information area: Centered location row with a map pin icon and text “MELLOW CUP CCMALL 店”. Beneath it add the sentence “期待与你相遇，随手一拍也出片，到店还可领咖啡”. Then create exactly 3 bottom info blocks: left block shows “2026” and “开业时间”; center block shows CCMALL 时代广场 L1 层; right block contains a visible black-and-white QR code with caption “扫码了解更多”. Finish with a dark brown footer strip containing spaced uppercase text “SLOW COFFEE, SOFT MOMENTS.”

Color and materials: Cream, latte beige, espresso brown, white typography, polished marble, coffee foam swirls, kraft paper tape, soft shadows, photorealistic 3D mockup blended with clean graphic poster design.

Constraints: Use exactly 3 visible hoarding panels, exactly 3 bottom info blocks, exactly 1 QR code, and exactly 1 takeaway cup. Keep the typography crisp and centered, preserve the listed Chinese and English text accurately, do not add extra logos, people, or unrelated products.\
